title: Martin Romualdez transferred to QC jail in Payatas
summary: Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez is now at the Quezon City Jail Male Dormitory in Payatas, after leaving the University of the Philippines-Philippine General Hospital (UP-PGH) on Monday night.
